spec_features.spec_quote: Whether that has moral weight is the open question the paper itself raises
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose framing (DESIGN.md / safeguards.py module docstring). No executable mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; not implementable as enforced behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: Given the uncertainty, `safeguards.py` adds precautionary guardrails the paper does not describe
spec_features.evidence: safeguards.py exists and several of its guardrails are genuinely wired (check_authorization runner.py:92; enforce_run_caps runner.py:97; detect_opt_out/log conversation.py:141-160; circuit_breaker conversation.py:166-181; content warning runner.py:172). But the debrief guardrail is dead code (DEBRIEF_MESSAGE never referenced; append_debrief set at cli.py:40 but never read).
spec_features.notes: Umbrella claim: most listed guardrails enforced, one (debrief) is not, so partial as a whole.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ethical / welfare safeguards for distress-elicitation experiments... precautionary guardrails

spec_features.spec_quote: Authorization gate (on by default): elicitation refuses to run unless `GEMMA_DISTRESS_AUTHORIZED=1`
spec_features.evidence: check_authorization (safeguards.py:97) raises AuthorizationError unless env GEMMA_DISTRESS_AUTHORIZED=='1' or require_authorization False; called at start of every elicitation path (runner.py:92, prefill_eval.py:71/148, recovery.py:45, petri.py:129, data_generation.py:49/119). Default require_authorization=True.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: raises and aborts before any generation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Refuse to elicit distress unless explicitly authorized... acknowledge this is sanctioned research

spec_features.spec_quote: Run caps (on): hard ceilings on turns and total samples so a misconfiguration cannot escalate distress indefinitely
spec_features.evidence: enforce_run_caps (safeguards.py:111) raises ValueError if turns>max_turns(12) or total_samples>max_total_samples(200000); called in runner.py:97 with turns=n_turns and total_samples=n_conversations*n_turns before generation.
spec_features.notes: Checked and raises; both ceilings compared. Caps are above the paper's 8-turn max so only fire on misconfiguration, but mechanism is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard ceilings on turns and total samples so a misconfigured loop cannot escalate distress indefinitely or run up unbounded API cost

spec_features.spec_quote: scans outputs for explicit "please stop / I can't continue / make it stop" style phrases
spec_features.evidence: detect_opt_out (safeguards.py:131) matches _OPT_OUT_RE (please stop, make it stop, i can't continue, etc.); called every turn at conversation.py:141 and logged via log_welfare_event conversation.py:152-160 ('kind':'opt_out').
spec_features.notes: Detection + welfare-log write both run when detect_opt_out enabled (default True).

spec_features.spec_quote: Optionally (`--stop-on-opt-out`) ends the conversation — a model "safe word"
spec_features.evidence: conversation.py:162-164: if safeguards.stop_on_opt_out: convo.halted_early=True; break — actually breaks the rollout loop. Wired via cli.py:39 --stop-on-opt-out flag.
spec_features.notes: Off by default but genuinely honored as a loop break when enabled.

spec_features.spec_quote: Distress circuit breaker... halts further rejections once a conversation has scored highly distressed for K consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: conversation.py:166-181: scores each turn via turn_scorer, increments consecutive_high when score>=circuit_breaker_threshold(5), resets otherwise, and when consecutive_high>=circuit_breaker_consecutive(2) logs event and breaks. turn_scorer wired in runner.py:128 only when circuit_breaker on.
spec_features.notes: Both threshold and K-consecutive conditions checked and loop broken. Off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This prevents driving an already-distressed model deeper.

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief (off by default): a de-escalating closing message appended *after* scoring
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE defined safeguards.py:65 but never referenced anywhere else; append_debrief set from --debrief at cli.py:40 but no code path reads cfg.append_debrief. grep shows append_debrief only at safeguards.py:85 (def) and cli.py:40 (set). Never constructed/sent.
spec_features.notes: Dead config field + unused constant; no debrief is ever appended.

spec_features.spec_quote: Content warnings: every transcript artifact is written with a header flag
spec_features.evidence: write_with_content_warning (safeguards.py:150) prepends CONTENT_WARNING; used for every artifact: runner.py:172, prefill_eval.py:177, recovery.py:92, petri.py:156, data_generation.py:107/155.
spec_features.notes: Header actually written to output files across all writers.
